​
The Adizero Adios Pro 5 is here 😮‍💨​
​
Introducing our new race-day super shoe built with the same world-record-breaking innovation as the Pro Evo 3. ​
​
🪶 23g lighter than the Adios Pro 4, weighing an average of 177g.​
​
🔋 9% more energy return, powered by new ENERGYRIM technology and LIGHTSTRIKE PRO foam.​
​
💪 Built to sustain speed deeper into marathons, with greater comfort, stability and grip.​
​
Available globally now via adidas.com, the adidas app and selected retailers.​

#ADIZERO Adios Pro 5

Fast approaching, quicker than ever...      ​
​
adidas Agravic Speed Ultra Evo is built to run trails faster than ever before, from the minds of elite athletes to the feet of top trail runners.​
​
~ A featherlight TRAILOCK upper for long-distance comfort and protection in the terrain.​
​
~ Dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam - tuned in to trails to deliver maximum energy return over those long trails.​
​
~ A fine-tuned landing platform building your confidence with smooth transition, stability and roll-off.​
​
Coming on the 25th August, in limited quantities.​ #Agravic

#ADIZERO Adios Pro 5​

Once you make history, the only way forward is to reinvent it.​
​
Designed to adapt to any course & every road, ENERGYRIM is the carbon-infused technology behind three world records in the Adizero Adios Pro Evo 3, including the first sub-two-hour marathon, and victory on the trails in the Agravic Speed Ultra.​
​
One innovation. Endless expressions of speed.​
